name: Rallypoint cmd
description: Self-hosted web panel for Steam dedicated game servers. Installs, starts, monitors, configures, backs up and updates game servers via SteamCMD and systemd, with a live console, restart schedules and per-game settings editors for Palworld and Enshrouded.

notes.text: The container starts with an empty server list — add games from the panel and each installs into /opt/games/<slug>. Size the disk for what you plan to run: ARK: Survival Evolved alone wants ~100 GB, Rust and Counter-Strike 2 ~35 GB each.

The panel listens on plain HTTP and is a single-admin console. Do not port-forward it directly — reach it over a VPN, a Cloudflare Tunnel, or an HTTPS reverse proxy, then set COOKIE_SECURE=true and TRUSTED_PROXY=true in the config file.
If no admin password was supplied, one is generated at install time and written to /etc/rallypoint-cmd/panel.env. Change it after first login.
SteamCMD is 32-bit, so the container enables i386 multiarch. Wine is installed as well, for dedicated servers that ship Windows-only binaries (Enshrouded).
